title: Proteus

inlines.v: PRO'TEUS, noun [Latin] In mythology, a marine deity, the son of Oceanus and Tethys, whose distinguishing characteristic was the faculty of assuming different shapes. Hence we denominate one who easily changes his form or principles, a proteus
